name: Minoran League
relationship: Recently independent league whose central government has been seized by Cedric. Caricas, Nethereum, Ovesos and Nesdor are separately fighting for independence and loosely coordinating.

name: Pyrosi Empire
capital: Pyra, spanning West Pyros and East Pyros
relationship: Independent sprawling empire; potential adversary on Marosh's fortified Dinelv frontier.

name: Telemonia
capital: Telemonia; capital settlement not specified in this request
relationship: Independent state; Legemum supplies slave-tilled agricultural production.

name: Ascarth
relationship: Independent state.

name: Nylon / Eer
relationship: Independent, strongly defended city-state.

name: Selemis
relationship: Maritime state controlling the listed island regions.

name: Marosh
capital: New town in Marosh; name and site undecided
relationship: Independent state with fortified Dinelv defenses against Pyros.

name: Hama
capital: Small town in Hama; name not specified
relationship: Independent small state.

name: Izol
relationship: Independent human state representing the Coalition against Ambron. A successful Coalition Chapter 1 campaign brings Moros Plain under Izol.

name: West Suval
relationship: Independent successor state in the three-way Suval division; held by the republican Coalition at the opening and allied with Izol against Ambron.

name: Elod
relationship: Independent state in the three-way Suval division.

name: South Suval
relationship: Independent successor state in the three-way Suval division.

name: Ambroni Empire
relationship: Nominal vassal of the High King of the Stone Fist, now stronger than Lond and effectively autonomous. Maintains the oath for Cref tradition while adopting southern ways. Independent Feradom is its ally.

name: Feradom
relationship: Independent ally of the Ambroni Empire.

name: Mithala
capital: Mithala, the joint city spanning all four Mithala regions
relationship: Nominal vassal of the High King of the Stone Fist; distance leaves the High King with little practical sway. Uneasy peace with Henborth centaurs.

name: Celder
relationship: One human state, nominally a vassal of the High King of the Stone Fist; distance leaves the High King with little practical sway. Uneasy peace with Henborth centaurs.

name: Yunethre Free State
relationship: Independent town-led polity allied with the distinct Yunethre centaur polity; shared region.

name: Yunethre Centaurs
capital: Mobile camps; existing Bane's Camp is an anchor, not a sedentary capital
relationship: Mobile centaur society allied with the Yunethre Free State; shared region rather than subordinate subjects.

name: Henborth Centaurs
capital: Mobile camps; no fixed capital specified
relationship: Distinct centaur polity controlling Henborth; uneasy peace with Mithala and Celder after centuries of conflict.

name: Mountain Elfland
relationship: Sevron's Night Elves are pale-skinned and red-eyed. They live underground, shun sunlight and venture onto the surface only at night. Their small hidden kingdom survives beneath West Oremindi. The orc chieftains occupy the mountain surface but have not found the city. It does not control the four surface regions.

name: Wood Elfland
capital: Royal heart in Central Ibenwood; settlement name undecided
relationship: Realm of the wood elves, also known as Day Elves, claiming all five Ibenwood regions; cooperative trade with Ibenal and Alezhor. They are distinct from Sevron's underground Night Elves.

name: Ibenal
relationship: Peaceful isolationist human state; cooperates and trades selectively with Wood Elfland; tension with Alezhor over trade and sea passage.

name: Alezhor
relationship: Open maritime human merchant state with far-ranging explorers; friendly to Wood Elfland; tension with Ibenal over access to its seas.

name: Thalmagar's Empire
capital: Public seat: Black Fortress, Cape Thalmagar. Secret true capital: Urubond.
relationship: Thalmagar rules Cape Thalmagar and the concealed land of Urubond. His independent neighbor Kudan fears and opposes him; its conquest is an intended campaign development, not an opening possession. Narcosh is friendly and considering alignment, but has not joined him. Existing secret vassals remain separate political actors.

name: Caricas independence movement
relationship: Separate independence war against the Cedric-controlled Minoran League; loose coordination with the other three member rebellions.

name: Nethereum independence movement
relationship: Separate independence war against the Cedric-controlled Minoran League; loose coordination with the other three member rebellions.

name: Ovesos independence movement
relationship: Separate independence war against the Cedric-controlled Minoran League; loose coordination with the other three member rebellions.

name: Nesdor independence movement
relationship: Separate independence war against the Cedric-controlled Minoran League; loose coordination with the other three member rebellions.

name: High Kingdom of the Stonefist / Lond
capital: Stonefist; exact atlas placement to confirm
relationship: Overlord of eight northern lower kingdoms and nominal overlord of Mithala, Celder and Ambron. The three distant crowns are effectively autonomous; Ambron is stronger than Lond. Allied to the Acorwood honorary king.

name: Endevor
capital: Not specified in the request; Stroven is an existing lore candidate
relationship: Lower kingdom / vassal of Stonefist

name: Nonoth
relationship: Lower kingdom / vassal of Stonefist

name: Thoth
relationship: Lower kingdom / vassal of Stonefist

name: Orse
relationship: Lower kingdom / vassal of Stonefist

name: Witherst
relationship: Lower kingdom / vassal of Stonefist

name: Riesov
relationship: Lower kingdom / vassal of Stonefist

name: Ganun
relationship: Lower kingdom / vassal of Stonefist

name: Ithzel
capital: East Ithzel; named settlement unclear in transcript
relationship: Returning human lower king of the Stone Fist, reclaiming Ithzel from the Blood Prince's undead. Holds the east while the west remains under the prince's faction.

name: Acreland (Acorwood realm)
relationship: Independent Acorwood polity allied to Stonefist; honorary lower kingship, not an ordinary human vassal

name: Western dwarf kingdom (working name)
relationship: Separate dwarf state, mutually at peace with the other Baldro dwarf state, each of the four independent Goblinland factions and the Eshtor undead polity against human expansion. This establishes neither secret vassalage to Thalmagar nor automatic military passage.

name: Eastern dwarf kingdom (working name)
relationship: Separate dwarf state, mutually at peace with the other Baldro dwarf state, each of the four independent Goblinland factions and the Eshtor undead polity against human expansion. This establishes neither secret vassalage to Thalmagar nor automatic military passage.

name: Undead Land (working name)
relationship: Separate undead polity outside Ganun's effective control; its duke is a secret vassal of Thalmagar. Mutually at peace with each of the four independent Goblinland factions and both Baldro dwarf states against human expansion. North Gorgi separately has confirmed secret Thalmagar vassalage; the other partners do not acquire it through this peace.

name: Orgmala goblin faction
relationship: Independent goblin faction allied with the other three members of the loose Goblinland confederation, with little coordination and no shared command. Mutually at peace with the Eshtor undead polity and both Baldro dwarf states.

name: South Gorgi goblin faction (working atlas resolution)
relationship: Independent goblin faction allied with the other three members of the loose Goblinland confederation, with little coordination and no shared command. Mutually at peace with the Eshtor undead polity and both Baldro dwarf states.

name: Gorgiwood goblin faction
relationship: Independent goblin faction allied with the other three members of the loose Goblinland confederation, with little coordination and no shared command. Mutually at peace with the Eshtor undead polity and both Baldro dwarf states.

name: North Gorgi goblin faction
relationship: Independent goblin faction allied with the other three members of the loose Goblinland confederation, with little coordination and no shared command. Mutually at peace with the Eshtor undead polity and both Baldro dwarf states. Secretly a vassal of Thalmagar; this allegiance does not bind the other confederation members.

name: Blood Prince's island faction
capital: Island seat unspecified; Wilhelm is personally in Minora
relationship: Second northern undead faction, ruled by the Blood Prince and secretly subordinate to Thalmagar. Contests Ithzel against the returned human lower king.

name: Kudan
relationship: Independent human coastal kingdom. Its only major settlement is Kudan Town, with farms in the surrounding countryside. Hostile to and afraid of Thalmagar; his conquest of Kudan belongs to later campaign progression.

name: Narcosh
people: People of mixed human and goblin ancestry
relationship: Independent country, friendly toward Thalmagar and considering alignment without having decided. Allows northern orc warbands passage through its lands toward the Oremindi, via the Orthakar woodland corridor. Disputes Acor Wetlands with Acreland and Endevor.

name: West Oremindi Clan
relationship: An independent orc chieftainship occupying the mountain surface and former human settlements. Rivals the other three chieftains; there is no united orc state or settled allegiance to Thalmagar. Its chief’s personal name is undecided.

name: East Oremindi Clan
relationship: An independent orc chieftainship occupying the mountain surface and former human settlements. Rivals the other three chieftains; there is no united orc state or settled allegiance to Thalmagar. Its chief’s personal name is undecided.

name: North Oremindi Clan
relationship: An independent orc chieftainship occupying the mountain surface and former human settlements. Rivals the other three chieftains; there is no united orc state or settled allegiance to Thalmagar. Its chief’s personal name is undecided.

name: South Oremindi Clan
relationship: An independent orc chieftainship occupying the mountain surface and former human settlements. Rivals the other three chieftains; there is no united orc state or settled allegiance to Thalmagar. Its chief’s personal name is undecided.

name: Oremindi Kingdom
capital: A refugee camp; the old royal seat is lost
relationship: Nearly destroyed human kingdom. Once an ineffective claim over isolated mountain communities, the monarchy became a rallying point against the orc invasions. Ruined settlements and a small surviving refuge remain; the king has no sole region-wide control. The four orc chiefs now occupy the surface.
